## Howdy,

## I'm Pat Szot _(last name pronounced like shut) 🇵🇱_ I'm a brand designer and well-rounded art director. I have over a decade of experience producing high-quality, thoughtful marketing materials.
I use the word 'system' because my work is heavily influenced from a product background. Although, I'm increasingly interested in extending brands to different surfaces – software, conferences, print, 3D, video, motion design, physical activations, dealer's choice.

After all the career talk though, I'm just an ambitious southern boy who doubled-down on making rules, breaking rules, type-a personality traits, and loving the way things look in a series. I grew up customizing cars in the _Need for Speed_ games on Playstation, toured in a metal band for three years, went to college, shaved my head, and somehow ended up with degrees in both finance and design.

Before graduating university, I freelanced, subcontracted with a big tech company, and was recruited to Deloitte Digital in D.C. for my first full-time job. There I helped modernize brand touch points for a handful of federal agencies.

A number of years ago, I moved to NYC to practice in a commercial advertising agency. At the beginning of 2022 I made the switch to start up land, where I have been collaborating, producing, and experimenting with the amazing teams at Webflow since.
